name: Lisa Patnaik

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Lisa Patnaik, named Lisha Patnaik in her supplied biography, grew up in Damanjodi, Odisha. That account describes an early interest in English poetry and a writing practice continued alongside work in information technology. She presents poetry as a personal space for reflection and solace.

Her two Kabita Live poems return to love through dreams and memory. In ‘I see you!’, a longed-for reunion is revealed as a dream, yet its remembered warmth remains valuable to the speaker. ‘One more love’ follows affection that persists after separation and eventually finds a place in poems themselves. Both works attend to feelings that continue beyond an actual meeting.
